message: Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib && grep -n "sam_hdr_tid2name\|sam_hdr_tid2len" sam.c | head -20

message.content:
This commit introduces `sam_hdr_tid2name(h, b->core.tid)` and `sam_hdr_tid2len(h, b->core.tid)`. If `b->core.tid` is out of range (e.g., -1 or beyond the number of references), these functions could read out of bounds. This is likely the heap-buffer-overflow READ.

Let me look at `sam_hdr_tid2name` and `sam_hdr_tid2len`.
